recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-17461 unless FHIR-I reopens the broader search-modifier design; this issue should not be used to remove current string :text guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-17461 was a Published FHIR-core search issue with a Persuasive with Modification resolution. It questioned wording that mentioned advanced text handling via the :text modifier and accepted a modified change to the Text Search Parameters section clarifying that _text and _content search narrative/content and should support sophisticated text search just like string parameters using :text.
initial_application: The issue appears to have been applied by SVN revision 14256, represented in git as 06d8e8a000752f7b50cc02bfd7b028dcf8f5ae51, which added the accepted comparison to string parameters using the :text modifier in source/search.html. The git subject references GF#15973, but the git-svn revision matches the FHIR-17461 Jira application comment.
additional_context: The linked Zulip discussion records that :text was intentional and distinct from _text: _text is a resource-wide search parameter, while :text is a modifier on applicable search parameters. FHIR-I minutes from 2018-07-30 record FHIR-17461 in the approved Persuasive with Modification block vote. A later FHIR-20001 reconciliation on the combined branch also treated FHIR-17461 as supporting evidence that string :text remains intentional.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. Current source/search.html defines text as a string modifier with advanced text handling and already contains the accepted _text/_content Text Search Parameters paragraph, so replacing the current string :text guidance with _text would be incorrect.

related_jiras.note: Already represented on the combined branch; its reconciliation cited FHIR-17461 as evidence that string :text remains intentional and distinct from _text.
